plain_english: When you decide something is right and you need to do it, don't worry about people seeing you do it. Even if they don't understand. If what you're doing is wrong, then don't do it at all. But if it's right, why fear people who judge you incorrectly?
original_excerpt: When you do anything from a clear judgment that it ought to be done, never shrink from being seen to do it, even though the world should misunderstand it; for if you are not acting rightly, shun the action itself; if you are, why fear those who wrongly censure you?
